entries.conclusion: Current callback implementation: react-use-event-hook 0.9.6, verified immutable npm archive with lockfile SHA512 integrity, MIT, Copyright (c) 2022 Scott Rippey. OpenCraft retains only its typed useStableEvent adapter. Other react-runtime files are unchanged OpenCraft presentation helpers/exports/metadata. This disposition applies to the replacement source, not former implementations or historical commits; see PROVENANCE.md for exact archive integrity, notice distribution and verification limits.
